nodes.body: <<FILL role=setup words=70 beats='At the Harlow junk shop, Wren buys a tarnished chess set for two pounds. At home she counts thirty-three pieces. The extra rook has a tiny fox carved on its base. Mrs Harlow says the set came from Penrose House, near the harbor.'>>

<<FILL role=explore words=80 beats='Wren sets the rook on her kitchen table and turns it in the light. The fox seems to wink. She opens her notebook and writes three questions: who carved it, who lost it, and why it was never with the rest. Each answer seems to start down a different road.'>>

choices.label: Follow the clue to Penrose House

nodes.body: <<FILL role=explore words=100 beats='Wren pedals to Penrose House and meets Mr Nye. The hall smells of old paper. Above the fireplace hangs a fox sign with the initials T.B. Mr Nye unlocks a cabinet of dusty chess sets, and Wren feels the extra rook warm in her pocket.'>>

<<FILL role=explore words=100 beats='Inside the locked cabinet, Wren finds a receipt from the Bowe workshop dated 1927. It lists one set of thirty-two pieces and one extra rook for the Meridian captain. Wren copies the words into her notebook and sets off.'>>

choices.label: Go to the old Bowe workshop

nodes.body: <<FILL role=transition words=100 beats='The old Bowe workshop is now a tea shop called The Fox and Leaf. The owner lets Wren look at a framed photograph of the harbor, where the steamer Meridian once waited. A second photograph shows Tomas Bowe holding a carving knife.'>>

<<FILL role=explore words=100 beats='In the town library, archivist Ms Bell unrolls a 1927 newspaper. The Meridian sank in a storm, and a small column mentions a Bowe chess set in the cargo. Wren writes down every name she can read.'>>

<<FILL role=climax words=100 beats='Wren spreads her notes on a bench. The fox rook, the Meridian, and the Bowe workshop all point to a collector named Pike. She holds the rook up to the light and decides how to finish the trail.'>>

choices.label: Return the rook to the family

nodes.body: <<FILL role=explore words=100 beats='Wren holds the rook under a lamp and finds initials hidden in the fox's tail. The carving matches Tomas Bowe's other work, but the wood is older than the rest of the set.'>>

<<FILL role=explore words=100 beats='Using a magnifying glass, Wren sees a hairline crack filled with dark resin. The resin smells of pine, a sign the piece was carved far from the coast. She notes it in her book.'>>

<<FILL role=explore words=100 beats='Wren compares the rook's base with a photograph of the Meridian cargo. The sizes match, and a faint M is stamped inside the rim. She is sure the piece came from the lost ship.'>>

<<FILL role=explore words=100 beats='Mrs Harlow brings out a leather case that came with the chess set. The case has a stamped fox and the letters T.B. Wren remembers that the Bowe workshop used the same mark.'>>
<<FILL role=explore words=100 beats='Wren finds an old price tag tucked inside the case. It reads one extra piece, not for sale. The handwriting matches the Penrose receipt.'>>

choices.label: Ask Mrs Harlow for the box

nodes.body: <<FILL role=explore words=100 beats='At Penrose House, Wren dusts off a portrait of a young woman with a fox pin. Mr Nye says she was Ada Bowe, Tomas's sister, who moved to the Yarrow family.'>>
<<FILL role=explore words=100 beats='Wren examines the portrait frame. Behind the photo is a note: The extra rook was for Ada, to keep her close.'>>

choices.label: Show the note to Mr Nye

nodes.body: <<FILL role=explore words=100 beats='Mr Nye lets Wren into the tower room, where an old chess table stands. The table's corner has a fox-shaped mark exactly like the one on the rook.'>>

choices.label: Make a rubbing of the mark

nodes.body: <<FILL role=explore words=100 beats='Wren traces the fox mark with a pencil. The rubbing matches the rook base perfectly, proving the table and the piece came from the same maker.'>>
<<FILL role=explore words=100 beats='The tea shop owner shows Wren a ledger of old orders. One entry reads Mrs Ada Yarrow, Bellhaven, one chess set with extra rook.'>>
<<FILL role=explore words=100 beats='Wren follows the ledger to the city archive. A property card says Yarrow Antiques moved from Market Street to Bellhaven in 1928.'>>
<<FILL role=explore words=100 beats='Wren finds a deed with Ada Yarrow's signature. Next to it is a sticker: From the Bowe workshop, 1927.'>>
<<FILL role=explore words=100 beats='The tea shop owner mentions a hidden drawer under the counter. Wren opens it and finds a tarnished rook, not the extra one, but carved by the same hand.'>>

<<FILL role=explore words=100 beats='In the drawer, Wren finds a receipt for the Meridian's chess table. The table was made for the captain's cabin, and the extra rook was added at the last minute.'>>
<<FILL role=explore words=100 beats='At the library, Wren checks the coastal map. The Meridian's route passes close to the old lighthouse, where the keeper once collected wrecks.'>>
<<FILL role=explore words=100 beats='The library has a lighthouse keeper's diary from 1927. It says the keeper saved a small crate from the Meridian and gave it to a Bellhaven dealer.'>>
<<FILL role=explore words=100 beats='Wren opens the diary to October 1927. A pressed flower marks a page about a woman named Ada who came to collect the crate.'>>
<<FILL role=explore words=100 beats='The archivist finds a photograph of the Bellhaven dealer, Mr Pike, holding a wooden rook. The rook has a fox on its base.'>>
<<FILL role=explore words=100 beats='Wren compares the photograph to her own rook. The grain of the wood matches, and the fox's eye is chipped the same way.'>>
<<FILL role=explore words=100 beats='At the harbor office, Wren asks the dockmaster about Mr Pike. He says Pike bought several Meridian cargo pieces from the salvage yard.'>>
<<FILL role=explore words=100 beats='The dockmaster gives Wren a receipt with Pike's address. The address is the old lighthouse keeper's cottage, now an antique shop.'>>
<<FILL role=explore words=100 beats='Wren reads the final line of the receipt: one extra rook, delivered by request of Ada Yarrow. The circle is complete.'>>

choices.label: Give the rook to the family

nodes.body: <<FILL role=explore words=100 beats='Wren rides to the antique shop and finds Mr Pike polishing a clock. When she shows the rook, his hands stop moving.'>>
<<FILL role=explore words=100 beats='Mr Pike nods and says, I sold that piece to the Harlow shop myself. It was meant to go back to the Yarrow family, but I lost the address.'>>
<<FILL role=ending words=100 beats='Wren places the rook on the Yarrow board, and it fits a gap no one noticed. The family invites her to play, and the fox rook leads her to victory.'>>

ending.title: The Fox Rook Finds a Player

nodes.body: <<FILL role=ending words=100 beats='Wren returns to the Harlow shop and sets the rook into the wooden case. The lid closes perfectly, and Mrs Harlow claps her hands.'>>
<<FILL role=ending words=100 beats='The hidden resin leads Wren to a river workshop, but the carver moved away. She leaves with a map and a promise to return.'>>
<<FILL role=ending words=100 beats='Wren finds a note naming Ada Yarrow, but no one can tell her where Ada went. She tucks the note into the chess box.'>>
<<FILL role=ending words=100 beats='At the salvage yard, Wren opens a waterlogged crate and finds only broken chessmen. The fox rook is not there, and rain starts to fall.'>>
<<FILL role=ending words=100 beats='The ledger proves the extra rook was a real order. Wren adds the proof to her notebook, and the mystery feels within reach.'>>
<<FILL role=ending words=100 beats='The note under the portrait gives Wren a name, but not a place. She leaves Penrose House with more questions than answers.'>>
<<FILL role=ending words=100 beats='The crew photograph shows a fox rook on the captain's table. Wren studies it until the library closes.'>>
<<FILL role=ending words=100 beats='The note talks about a lonely player named Ada. Wren decides to find the Yarrow family before saying anything.'>>
<<FILL role=ending words=100 beats='A collector corners Wren in the tea shop and demands the rook. She hides it in a sugar tin, but he takes the whole tin.'>>
<<FILL role=ending words=100 beats='Mr Yarrow and Mrs Harlow shake hands. The rook stays at the Harlow shop on loan, and Wren is given a key to the display case.'>>
<<FILL role=ending words=100 beats='Mr Pike offers a reward, but Wren declines. She asks him to return the rook to the Yarrow family, and he agrees.'>>
<<FILL role=ending words=100 beats='Wren donates the rook to the Bellhaven Museum. A label reads carved by Tomas Bowe for Ada Yarrow, and she visits it every Saturday.'>>
<<FILL role=ending words=100 beats='Wren stays at the tea shop and finds a fox-marked napkin, but no rook. She leaves with a promise to return.'>>
